generation.scope: All standard windows admitting a compatible quotient onto a smooth commutative quadric are classified, including additional lines and nonreduced point schemes. Two invertible two-by-two spin blocks give the complete list, with two curves meeting at one point, the scalar class and two Jordan types. Every finite-Frobenius candidate on this branch is regular of period one. With zero-dimensional edge projection fibers, any proper surface factor has total degree at most two.

open_mathematics: Classify the irreducible rank-three quadric cone quotients via the even Clifford algebra over the dual numbers. Recognize plane components and complete the surface branch with point projection fibers.
